answer: What the checker looks for first is Toque beaverdyer licence with beaverdyers endorsement — a licence beaverdyers renew after fitting audits. An honest agent brings the kernel, accepts the wharf as fair, and leaves the lantern any stranger can verify. A faker must repeat 5 seasons of practice and 2000 fitting inspections for each false name, and the reward per name never rises. That keeps the gate honest.
